scripts.build: bun run --cwd api build && bun run --cwd app build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names app,api --prefix-colors auto "bun --filter @hang/live run dev" "bun --filter @hang/api-server run dev"
scripts.check: bun run --cwd api check && bun run --cwd app check
scripts.deploy: bun run --cwd api deploy && bun run --cwd app deploy
